title: Payment of Rent on Safe Deposit Boxes: Methods, Years Paid in Advance and Automatic Debit
content:
Rent on Safe Deposit Boxes may be paid by automatic debit from a PCB checking account, by transfer from a PCB checking account, in cash, or by check.

## Years paid in advance

Up to 3 rental years may be paid in advance. Years after the current one receive 5 percent off their net rent.

Worked on a hypothetical figure: where a year after the current one is paid in advance and the net rent for that year is $110.00, the amount for that year is $110.00 less 5 percent, which is $104.50. The $110.00 here is a hypothetical input, not a rent the bank charges.

## Automatic debit

Where automatic debit is in force, the named checking account is debited on the rent due date.

The account named for automatic debit must be a checking account of the same customer as the box rental, and its status must be active.

## What settles the account standard

The three things that must hold of the account named are settled from the bank's own record of that checking account, read before the automatic debit instruction is recorded and matched to the account named in the instruction: that it is a checking account, that its owner is the same customer who holds the box rental, and that its status is active.

| The account named | Satisfies the standard |
| --- | --- |
| An active checking account of the lessee | yes |
| A checking account of the lessee whose status is anything other than active | no |
| An active checking account belonging to someone other than the lessee | no |

The lessee's word that the account is theirs and open does not settle the standard; the record of the account does.
